newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW cuts food retail forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW cuts food retail forecasts.

text.p: Earnings estimates for food retail stocks were cut at BZW in the wake of Safeway Plc's cautious trading statement on Friday, market sources said.

BZW issued an "underweight" rating on the sector and trimmed its pre-tax profit estimate for Safeway by ten million stg to 430 million for the year ending March 1997, and by 15 million to 460 million for the year after.
The brokerage cut its rating on Safeway to "hold" from "buy," sources said.
BZW also cut its estimates for pre-tax profit as ASDA Group Plc by ten million stg to 339 million for the year ending April 1997 and by 15 million stg to 382 million for the year after.
For Tesco it cut its fiscal 1997 estimate by five million stg to 755 million and its 1998 forecast by ten million stg to 820 million. It rated Tesco "hold" and ASDA "sell," sources said.
Shares in Safeway were down 4-1/2p at 357-1/2 by 1445 GMT, Tesco was down 1-1/2p at 343, J Sainsbury Plc was unchanged at 321 while ASDA was up 1/4p at 115.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
On Friday Safeway warned that profits could be hit by a slowdown in sales growth in the first 16 weeks of the second half of the current year.
